verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform does issue its own API credentials. Developers register an account, form teams, get sandbox access with test data, and receive production keys only after passing a demo. That gives per-application keys with environment separation for the Case Status and FOIA APIs. Nothing documents scoping those keys to specific APIs, operations or cases, nor any self-service issuance of least-privilege or agent-specific credentials. missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permissions, read-only or per-API restriction controls, self-service key issuance and revocation, agent-oriented credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration
